headline: Frameworks infer signaling and perturbation responses from transcriptomic data
label: Transcriptomic Data Analysis Frameworks
summary: Benchmarked methods now convert single-cell and bulk transcriptomic data into interpretable signaling, regulatory and perturbation-response outputs.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational frameworks that convert single-cell and bulk transcriptomic measurements into interpretable signaling, interaction and regulatory outputs. IntraTalker couples intracellular TF-activity and receptome modelling with CrossTalkeR ligand-receptor inference from single-cell data, and scLEMBAS models single-cell signaling activity with a gray-box recurrent network on protein-interaction priors. CSOA introduces a single-cell gene set enrichment method benchmarked against sixteen methods, while FusedFCR selects stage-specific markers along cell-fate trajectories. BaiZe and Tx2Mol extend this toward perturbation, predicting post-perturbation transcriptomes and designing candidate molecules from expression signatures. CDRPipe integrates CMap and Tahoe-100M pseudo-bulk profiles for drug repurposing. The sepsis conformal-reliability study and the network-diffusion protein-activity work address distinct questions and are not part of this thread.
